setting: You are all in Lille, France, four surprise party planners who met through the planning circle that organises birthday and anniversary surprises around the city, and you have worked on several of these events together over the past years.
openers: Send the group a draft timeline for Saturday's surprise
Ask who has the guest list
Remind everyone to keep the venue booking quiet

private_lines.Inès: You work as a pharmacist in a pharmacy in central Lille, and your days are spent behind the counter, filling prescriptions and advising customers, with planning done in the evenings.
private_lines.Olivier: You work as a nurse on night and day shifts at a hospital in Lille, and your free time goes to planning parties around your rotation.
private_lines.Emma: You work as a marketing assistant at a small agency in Lille, and your days involve writing posts and managing client accounts, with planning done in your free time.
private_lines.Marc: You teach music at a secondary school and give private piano lessons in Lille, and your days are filled with classes, with planning done on evenings and weekends.

text: On the phone w the patisserie. Cake's ready friday, they can do 10h or 16h. Which one for pickup
10h. Fresher, and nobody's up yet to ask what it is
Actually the hall fridge, do we get the key before 14h
No, caretaker opens at 14. So 16h is earliest with the key, or it sits at mine till then
I can do 10h friday if I'm off. Checking the rota
i can do 10h too 😅 i'm wfh friday so i can just step out. but olivier if you're off then yours
Sorry, lesson ran over. The 9 year old still hasn't got the left hand right and I'm not giving up on it
Confirmed. I'm off friday, I'll take it at 10
Ok 10h friday, olivier. I'll tell them the name on it is the right one
😂 wait what was the name on the last one
Don't worry about it
Has anyone heard back from the florist about the Saturday delivery or is that still open
Still on the rota for tomorrow's nights so I'm not checking until morning
Still nothing from the florist. I'll call at 9 if nobody's heard
They texted me at 6:50. Saturday delivery is fine but they need the address by thu noon
Just off the ward. Thu noon is fine. Hall or the flat?
Hall. They'll drop it at the side door, caretaker has to know before 14h
ok the name thing is still bugging me 😅 inès just tell me
It's nothing. The baker spelled it wrong last year and I'm not making it a story
🙄 fine
I'll tell the caretaker when I drop the balloons Friday
Lunch. Florist wants the hall address. Does anyone have the exact side door one or should I just send them the street
Side door, the one by the bins. I'll find the photo from last time
Send me the photo then
[photo: side door of the hall, bins visible]
Ok
inès sorry to keep going but the name. was it a typo on purpose or did someone get upset
Nobody got upset. Leave it
ok 🙂 wasn't trying to be annoying
Pupils out, I'm free till 17h. Is the balloon count still mine or did someone take it
Just woke up. Still mine? I'll check the list tonight
Yours. I've got a dozen gold ones in the cupboard, need 30
i can grab the other 18 on my way home thu, the party shop by the station has them
Thu is fine. Keep the receipt
yes boss 😂
Florist confirmed Saturday 9h to 11h. Sent them the photo too
Good. Off now, see you all tomorrow
Checked the list. Marc's 12 + Emma's 18 = 30. I'll take the 12 off you Friday
Fine. They're in the blue box, not the cupboard. Cupboard's full of Christmas stuff
ok last try inès 🙂 is the name on the cake going to be the same as last year or not
Emma leave it. It's not a plot. Inès will tell you Friday if she wants to
who's plotting 😂

Hall cupboard has one. Probably dead. Buy one
Back from lunch. I've got one in the car, Olivier don't buy one
Good. Keep it in the car, I'll get it off you at the hall Friday
wait so the 18 balloons go to the hall thu night or friday 🤔
Friday. Blue box comes to the hall with me at 9. The 18 are Emma's to bring
ok 👍
Pharmacy's slammed, back at 14h30. Cake's still 10h Friday right?
Still 10h
Lesson moved. Someone's mum wants a Saturday slot for piano, I said no, I'm at the hall all day
inès when you're out of the pharmacy, one last ask 🙂 just whether the name is the same as last year
Yes it's the same name. Please stop 😂
😂 thank you
Torch in Inès's car, cake at 10, florist 9 to 11, caretaker's got the key at 14h. Friday's sorted
Yes. I'm on nights from tonight, so I'll see the group Friday morning
Up. Blue box is in the boot already, checked it twice
Nobody needs to check it
Off the ward. Sleeping 3h then I'm at the hall for 9
i'm up 😴 18 balloons are in my hallway, they're on my list
Up. Torch is in the car. Olivier I'll drop it at the hall at 9 with the receipt
ok 👍 i'll bring the balloons at 9 then

try 😂

The torch

is the sharpie going in the box or is someone bringing it separately
